aperiodic.title: 3GPP Ambient IoT Inventory with Aperiodic Paging

controls.title: Scenario
controls.description: Continuous-time CBRA rounds; one aperiodic page per round.
controls.eiAlways: The EI stage is always included in the round timing.

hints.nTot: Number of deployed devices before the sensitivity filter. The paper uses 15000.
hints.seed: Root seed. All random streams (population, access, impairments) are derived from it, so the same seed reproduces the run exactly.
hints.runtime: Interactive runs one episode with full traces. Paper batch runs several seeds and returns mean and 5–95 % bands.
hints.episodes: Number of independent seeds (base seed + i). The paper averages 100 episodes.
hints.harvesting: Single-source: only the reader's RF field. Multi-source: the reader plus every base station contributes harvested power.
hints.typeMix: Mixed keeps the paper's sensitivity-based Type 1 / 2a / 2b mix; the other options force one type.
hints.ng: Number of periodic paging groups. Each group is paged in turn; the aperiodic protocol has no groups.
hints.depletion: When ON, a device whose storage reaches E_low during a round turns off (paper behaviour). OFF reproduces the 'w/o depletion' ablation curves.
hints.ppo: Recurrent PPO adapts both L and p each round from the observed S1/S2a/S2b/I/C counts. It requires a trained checkpoint.
hints.lInitial: L for the first round; adaptive controllers change it afterwards.
hints.controller: PFSA/PZE keeps L fixed and adapts p from the idle count (Kodialam & Nandagopal). DFSA-Schoute and CMEBE adapt the frame length.
hints.lFixed: Number of Msg1 slots per round (1 … {{lmax}}). L_max comes from the energy budget of the weakest device type.
hints.alpha: Reward weight between successes and Msg2/Msg3 collisions: r = ((1−α)·S·t_S − α·C2·t_C)/T_round.
hints.F: Number of frequency-domain access occasions per Msg1 slot.
hints.capture_ratio_db: A collided occasion is decoded if the strongest device exceeds the others by this ratio.
hints.missed_detection_rate: Probability that the reader misses a transmitted Msg1.
hints.false_alarm_rate: Probability that the reader detects a Msg1 on an idle occasion.
hints.max_time_s: The episode stops at this time even if devices remain unidentified.
hints.impairments: Enable capture, missed detection and false alarm in Msg1 decoding.
